problem_understanding: Maintain an array with range-add updates and range-sum queries on 1-indexed closed intervals.

steps.claim: Each segment-tree node stores the sum of its interval.
steps.justification: Range-sum queries can combine sums from disjoint covered nodes.

steps.claim: When adding delta to a fully covered interval, increase the node sum by delta * interval_length and accumulate lazy delta.
steps.justification: Every element in the interval increases by delta, so the interval sum changes by delta times the number of elements.

steps.claim: Before partially updating or querying children, push the node's lazy tag to both children.
steps.justification: Children must include all earlier full-cover updates before their subintervals are used.

steps.claim: Each operation visits O(log n) segment-tree nodes and all sums use 64-bit integers.
steps.justification: The recursion splits by interval boundaries, and sums may exceed 32-bit range.

algorithm: Segment tree with lazy range-add tags and range-sum queries.
correctness_argument: The tree invariant is that each node sum equals the true sum of its interval after applying its own lazy tag and all pushed ancestor updates. Full-cover updates maintain the invariant by adding delta times interval length. Partial operations push pending tags before descending, so child sums are up to date.
